data.compoundVerdictMeaning: Historical Holdout V5 returned FAIL. Synthetic Stress Holdout V2 is correctly never opened, so the validation is decided by stage one.

stages.whyNotOpened: Historical Holdout V5 returned FAIL. The frozen stage order forbids opening stage two after a stage-one failure: a synthetic stress pass says nothing about a candidate that failed the historical stage, and opening it would consume a one-shot resource for no evidence.

data.calibrationVersionNotBumped: a status transition alone does not bump possessionCalibrationVersion. It remains 1.1.0, the version the candidate was locked and measured at.
data.candidateNotUnlocked: a failed holdout does not unlock a candidate. Candidate 1 remains SELECTED and LOCKED, with its core and parameters exactly as they were before the seal opened.

noTuning.evidence: core and parameter-set hashes identical to the preflight taken before the seal opened, and all 53 parameters still at their registry defaults

statusesNotClaimed.why: Historical Holdout V5 returned FAIL, so Candidate 1 is not holdout-validated. No preview package is prepared and no deployment is authorized.

data.nextStep: a repair phase on the failing traits, producing Candidate 2, followed by NEW unseen holdouts. Historical V5 and, when it is eventually opened, Synthetic V2 are one-shot resources: neither can be reused to validate a repaired candidate.
